about: Captures kept on the device while the household could not take them, sent again: in what order, as whom, with what, and which stay (refused, failed, another member's).
android: core/carnet/Outbox.kt — flush, as carnet/shared/share/ShareHost.kt calls it

accepted.why: SyncService.flush calls CarnetAPI.saveArticle without a locale, whose default is "fr": every capture sent again is filed as French, whatever the member's language. Android sends the language the capture was made in (fr or en).

OkHttp (Android's HTTP engine) repeats a request once by itself when the server answers 408, as RFC 9110 allows; URLSession does not. Turning it off (retryOnConnectionFailure) would also stop OkHttp retrying a stale pooled connection. The item stays on both sides. (Locale "fr" on iOS: the ios-bug of the other cases.)
